text:
maria: Notes from the OrionHealth security review call — they require an on‑prem/private deployment with HSM-backed KMS, per-tenant signed audit exports for their QSA, and tenant-scoped RBAC for log access. Need a short technical writeup + evidence pack. Who can take the lead? cc @john @shay :wave:

john: I can own KMS/RBAC doc. Need clarification on whether they want HSM key material to originate in their HSM vs BYOK envelope only. Also rotation proof requirements (time window, signed attestations). Any raw call notes?

maria: They said "customer-managed HSM preferred; if not feasible then BYOK with HSM-wrapped keys and rotation attestations." QSA specifically asked for ways to demonstrate rotation in a test env and proof of key provenance for the last 12 months.

alex: For the on‑prem package we already support external HSM via PKCS#11 and a BYOK envelope flow. I can draft a rotation demo. Quick example to pull key history from a test node:

```bash
redwoodctl key history --key-id 7a1b2c3d --env orion-test --format json
```

That outputs rotation timestamps and signing certs. I’ll script an end-to-end demo.

shay: They also want RBAC separation: a LogAdmin role that can export/supply signed logs to auditors, and an Ops role that can view but not export. Do we have that granularity today?

john: We do resource-level permissions. Typical policy bits are: `audit:read`, `audit:export`, `key:rotate`, `key:manage-origin`. Example policy snippet for tenant-scoped export allow:

```json
{
  "principal": "role:LogAdmin",
  "actions": ["audit:read","audit:export"],
  "resource": "tenant:orion-health:audit-*"
}
```

We should add the example above to the customer-facing doc.

kiran: I’ll assemble the audit-evidence pack: signed logs (chain-of-trust), examples of SIEM forwarding (Splunk/hec & Azure Sentinel), retention config, and proof artifacts for rotation. Orion said they use Splunk + Sentinel. I’ll include ingestion sample configs.

maria: Action items: john — KMS & RBAC writeup (Thu EOD). alex — rotation demo script + PKCS#11 how-to (Wed). kiran — audit pack + SIEM forward examples (Thu). shay — QSA checklist & mapping to evidence (Thu). I’ll schedule a Friday dry run with OrionHealth. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Reminder created ticket INFR-2042: "onprem-hsm-orionhealth" assigned to eng-infra.

john: creating a docs branch now and will ping when PR is up (will attach policy examples and rotation logs).

maria: thanks — please add the demo artifacts into the evidence bucket under `s3://redwood-evidence/orionhealth/2026-03-dryrun` and flag anything requiring privileged access. I’ll send calendar invite for Fri dry run.

alex: noted — will include script & sample output (sanitized).

kiran: I’ll prepare a short README that maps each QSA item to the artifact filename.

maria: Great. If anything blocks, raise in this thread.
